notes:
Public domain by statute. The National Anthem Act declares both the melody and the words to be in the public domain; canada.ca states they "may be used without having to obtain permission from the government". Music Calixa Lavallée (1880), French words Adolphe-Basile Routhier (1880), English words Robert Stanley Weir (1908), amended in 2018 to replace "in all thy sons command" with "in all of us command" - the wording here.
The two are not translations of each other. Routhier's French and Weir's English are independent official texts that happen to share a lineation, so line 4 of one is not line 4 of the other in meaning - only in position. Both are transcribed from canada.ca.
